rules: All 247 records examined; photo candidates are 68 pinned URLs, 179 lack candidate (not image rejections).
Rows named WRONG_SUBJECT_OR_PLACE are hard mismatches visible from explicitly inconsistent subject/file titles; they require another photo and do not modify the historic user decision register.
Rows with generic site photos for specific physical relics are held for individual identity proof, not auto-rejected.
Rights and author fields copied from user research export are NOT freshly authenticated Commons licence checks; independent page + underlying object rights checks remain.
Photo pixel dimensions from research metadata do not show sharpness or native resolution; full-image inspection is still required.
KEEP is an independent editorial flag, untouched by technical rejection or hold.
No downloads, publications, changes to site media or prior KEEP decisions; no contact, costs or permission requests.
Never classify a candidate as definite wrong merely from a generic filename where file description may identify exact sacred object; inspect file page first.
